🏆 NEW CHAMPIONS CROWNED ON SMACKDOWN 🏆
Alexa Bliss and Tatum Paxley are back on top of the WWE women's tag team division.
They defeated Michin and B-Fab on the November 27 episode of SmackDown to capture the titles.
The bout featured outside involvement from Charlotte Flair and Jade Cargill.
